the_signal.headline: Prompt testing frameworks now separate production-ready from guesswork
the_signal.body: n8n's systematic prompt testing approach is becoming table stakes for AI workflows entering production. GTM engineers shipping AI features need regression detection and quality gates before hitting customers — guessing on prompts costs revenue, not just engineering time. This is the ops layer that separates reliable AI systems from ones that fail at scale.

thread_of_day.title: Coding Is Not Solved
thread_of_day.takeaway: Fundamental gaps in developer tooling and automation are still being discovered — relevance: AI coding assistants and workflow builders are solving real problems, not creating solutions in search of problems.

quote.text: API rate limiting doesn't have to mean failed workflows. Learn how limits work and how to handle 429s with retries, batching, and smart pacing.

whats_moving.context: Transactional outbox pattern is gaining traction for reliable event delivery in distributed systems — directly impacts how GTM teams orchestrate customer data flows.
n8n Gateway Credits reducing friction for model trials means non-technical revenue teams can experiment with LLM behavior without credential management overhead.
Deterministic vs. dynamic vs. agentic execution models now require different observability approaches — critical as workflows become more autonomous in customer journeys.
